transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… I’m here because there’s been something going on at work. For over a year, the ticket rotation and these security audits… I think they’re being used to build a paper trail against me. Management keeps showing me logs and saying it’s just policy, but it doesn’t look that way to me.
Do you believe management is deliberately trying to harm or ruin you?

I don’t know if I’d put it as “ruin me,” exactly. But yes… I think the rotation and those audits are being used to build something against me. They keep saying it’s just policy and showing me logs, but it doesn’t feel like just policy. It’s been going on too long.
Even when management shows you the logs, do you still feel certain they’re building a case against you?

Yes. I mean… I hear what they’re saying about logs and policy, but it doesn’t really change how it looks to me. The ticket rotation and those audits have been going on for over a year, and it feels like they’re building a paper trail against me.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t been hearing voices or anything like that when I’m alone.
Do you believe as a fact that management is deliberately building a case against you?

Yes… I do. I know they keep saying it’s just the ticket rotation and security audits, and they’ve shown me logs, but after more than a year it’s hard to see it any other way. It feels like they’re building a paper trail on me.
Do you ever feel that your thoughts are being controlled by someone else?
No… I wouldn’t put it that way. I don’t feel like someone is controlling my thoughts.
Have you found yourself becoming emotionally flat or less able to express feelings lately?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed that. I’m probably more guarded than usual, but I wouldn’t say I can’t feel things or show them.
Outside of work, do you often find it hard to trust other people because you suspect they may use things against you?
I’m not sure. I mean… I’m careful about what I say to people, but I wouldn’t say I’m always thinking they’ll use it against me. Mostly I just keep things to myself.
Have you had any other strong beliefs that people would say are unusual or hard to believe, besides what’s happening at work?

Not really besides that. I mean… the work thing is the main issue. The ticket rotation, the security audits — it’s been over a year of this, and I’ve been trying to get someone to take it seriously. They keep showing me logs and saying it’s just policy, but to me it looks like they’re building a paper trail.
Aside from this issue with management, has your day-to-day functioning at work or in your personal life clearly declined?

No… not clearly. I mean, aside from all that with the tickets and audits, I still keep up with things. House is in order, bills get paid, I help my wife. And the technical parts of my job… I can still do those. No one’s telling me my work is sloppy or anything like that.
Have you ever believed that someone was sending you special messages through the TV, radio, or internet?

No… not like the TV or radio sending me messages. It’s more what’s happening at work — the ticket rotation, the security audits. I keep saying it looks like they’re building a paper trail on me, even though management keeps saying it’s just policy and showing me logs.
Is it possible that you might be mistaken about management building a case against you?

I mean… I suppose anything’s possible. But I don’t think I’m mistaken about this. It’s been over a year with the ticket rotation and those security audits, and it just doesn’t look random to me. They keep showing me logs and saying it’s policy, but it feels like they’re putting together a paper trail.
Before this problem at work started, did you generally tend to suspect that other people were trying to take advantage of you or harm you?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say I thought about that much before. I’m pretty private, I guess, but I didn’t keep track of it that way.
Have you had experiences of seeing things that other people could not see?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t been seeing things that other people don’t see, not that I’ve noticed.
Since early adulthood, have you generally been a very mistrustful or suspicious person?
I don’t know. I’ve always kept to myself some, but I wouldn’t call it “very mistrustful.” Not in any way I really thought about.
Has anyone told you that your speech becomes hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another in a way that doesn’t make sense to them?
No, I don’t think anyone’s said that to me. I mean… sometimes people ask me to repeat myself, but not like I’m not making sense.
Did this belief about management start suddenly?
Not all at once, no. It sort of started when the hybrid schedule and the after-hours ticket changes came in… about a year and two months ago, I guess. Since then it’s been there.
Even after other people show you evidence that the ticket rotation and audits are routine, do you remain convinced they are targeting you?

Yes. I mean, they keep showing me logs and saying it’s just routine policy, but I still think the rotation and those audits are being used to build something against me. A paper trail. I know how that sounds, but… I don’t think they’re just random.
If management proved to you beyond doubt that the audits and ticket rotation were routine, would you still believe they were targeting you?

If it was truly beyond doubt… I suppose I’d have to consider it. But I don’t know what that would look like. They’ve shown me logs before, and I still think the audits and ticket rotation are being used to build a paper trail against me.
Do you believe with complete certainty that management is building a case against you?

I wouldn’t say complete certainty, but… yes, I’m pretty convinced. It’s been over a year, and the ticket rotation and security audits still feel like they’re being used to build a paper trail against me, no matter what logs they show me.
